title: 1988 AHSME Problem 25
statement:
\(X,\) \(Y,\) and \(Z\) are pairwise disjoint sets of people. The average ages of people in the sets \(X,\) \(Y,\) \(Z,\) \(X\cup Y,\) \(X\cup Z,\) and \(Y\cup Z\) are given in the table below.

 Set \(X\) \(Y\) \(Z\) \(X\cup Y\) \(X\cup Z\) \(Y\cup Z\)

 Average age of
 people in the set \(37\) \(23\) \(41\) \(29\) \(39.5\) \(33\)

 Find the average age of the people in the set \(X\cup Y\cup Z.\)

solutions.text:
Let the set sizes be \(x,y,z.\) The three union averages give \[ \begin{aligned} 37x+23y&=29(x+y),\\ 37x+41z&=39.5(x+z), \end{aligned} \] and \(23y+41z=33(y+z).\) Thus \(y=\frac{4x}{3}\) and \(z=\frac{5x}{3}.\) The total average is \[ \frac{\begin{gathered} 37x+23(\frac{4x}{3})\\ {}+41(\frac{5x}{3}) \end{gathered}} {x+\frac{4x}{3}+\frac{5x}{3}}=34. \]

Thus the correct answer is E.
hints: Let \(x,y,z\) be the sizes of the three sets
Each union average gives a linear relation among \(x,y,z\)
